---
title: "Figure 5 – Proximal Tubule cell analysis across timepoints"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2026-06-01"
output: html_document
description: >
  (A) UMAP of PT cells re-clustered into seven subpopulations (0–6).
  (B) Dot plot of subset markers grouped into S1/S2, adaptive S1/S2, and S3-injured identities.
  (C) Stacked bar chart of PT subset composition across timepoints (0, 3, 7, 28 dpi).
  (D) UMAPs split by timepoint.
  (E) Feature plots for the stress/injury markers Hspd1 (Hsp60) and Havcr1 (Kim-1).
  (F) Dot plot of subset-defining genes highlighting injury (cluster 4) and inflammatory markers.

Input:
  Single-cell: PT_Subclusters/PIPSeq_Annotated_OnlyPT_v0823.rds

Output: Results/Figures/Figure5/
---

## Load data

```{r load-data}
PTcells <- readRDS(paste0(SCIndir, "PIPSeq_Annotated_OnlyPT_v0823.rds"))
PTcells <- UpdateSeuratObject(PTcells)

timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")

# Cluster order 0–6 (numeric, as produced by re-clustering)
cluster_order <- as.character(0:6)
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = cluster_order)

cat("Cluster counts:\n")
print(table(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters))
cat("Timepoints:\n")
print(table(PTcells@meta.data$DataSet))
```

## Figure 5A: UMAP of PT subpopulations (numeric clusters 0–6)

```{r fig5a-umap-clusters, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = cluster_order)

Fig5A_UMAP <- DimPlot(
  PTcells,
  label   = TRUE,
  repel   = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "Proximal tubule subpopulations") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5A_PT_UMAP_Clusters.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5A_UMAP,
  width    = 5, height = 4
)
Fig5A_UMAP
```

## Figure 5B: Dot plot of PT subset markers (S1/S2, adaptive, S3-injured)

```{r fig5b-dotplot-markers, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = rev(cluster_order))
DefaultAssay(PTcells) <- "RNA"

# Markers grouped by PT segment identity
PT_Panmarkers <- c(
"Lrp2","Cubn","Aqp1","Slc34a1",
"Ggt1","Slc4a4"
)
S1_biased_markers <- c("Lrp2","Cubn","Slc34a1","Slc5a12")

S2_biased_markers <- c("Slc5a2","Slc22a6","Slc22a8","Slc13a2","Slc22a2")

S2_biased__markers <- c("Aqp7","Slc7a13","Slc7a12","Inmt")

all_pt_markers <- c(S1_biased_markers, S2_biased_markers, S2_biased__markers)
all_pt_markers <- all_pt_markers[all_pt_markers %in% rownames(PTcells)]

Fig5B_DotPlot <- DotPlot(
  PTcells,
  features  = all_pt_markers,
  cols      = c("RdBu"),
  dot.scale = 5
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(
    title = "PT subset marker expression (clusters 0-6)",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Cluster"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_colorbar(title = "AveExp"),
    size   = guide_legend(title  = "PerExp")
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5B_PT_MarkerDotPlot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5B_DotPlot,
  width    = 5, height = 3
)
Fig5B_DotPlot
```

## Figure 5C: Stacked bar chart of PT subset composition across timepoints

```{r fig5c-proportion, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = rev(cluster_order))
prop_df <- table(PTcells@meta.data$DataSet, PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Timepoint = Var1, Subset = Var2) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(pct = prop.table(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = timepoint_order),
    Subset    = factor(Subset,    levels = cluster_order)
  )

Fig5C_Prop <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = pct, fill = Subset)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Proportion", title = "PT subset composition across timepoints") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5C_PT_Proportion.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5C_Prop,
  width    = 4.5, height = 4
)
Fig5C_Prop
```

## Figure 5F: Dot plot of injury and inflammatory markers highlighting cluster 4

```{r fig5f-injury-inflam-dotplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = rev(cluster_order))
DefaultAssay(PTcells) <- "RNA"

# Injury, stress, and inflammatory gene set
injury_inflam_markers <- c(
  # Stress / heat-shock response
  "Hspd1", "Hsp90aa1", "Hsp90ab1", "Hmox1", "Hif1a",
  # Early tubular injury (Kim-1, Lcn2)
  "Havcr1", "Lcn2", "Clu","Dab2","Nrg1",
  # Maladaptive / failed repair
  "Vcam1", "Icam1", "Prom1", "Spp1", "Igfbp7", "Cst3",
  # Pro-fibrotic
  "Fn1", "C3", "Agt","Tgfb1","Col1a1","Col3a1",
  # Inflammatory
  "Il1b", "Nfkbia", "Nlrp3", "S100a8", "S100a9",
  "Cxcl1", "Cxcl2", "Ccl2","Ccl5","Tnfaip3",
  # chronic injury
  "Cdkn1a","Cdkn2a", "Serpine1", "Gdf15",
  # Cycling
  "Mki67", "Foxm1","Top2a", "Pcna", "Ccna2","Ccnb1", "Cdk1"

)
injury_inflam_markers <- injury_inflam_markers[injury_inflam_markers %in% rownames(PTcells)]


Fig5F_DotPlot <- DotPlot(
  PTcells,
  features  = injury_inflam_markers,
  cols      = c("RdBu"),
  dot.scale = 5
) +

    size   = guide_legend(title  = "PerExp")

    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5F_PT_InjuryInflam_DotPlot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5F_DotPlot,

)
```

## Figure 5G: DotPlot of PT transport function, dedifferentiation, and proliferation markers

```{r fig5g-transport-dediff-prolif, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = rev(cluster_order))
DefaultAssay(PTcells) <- "RNA"

# S1 identity / endocytic complex and ATPase subunits
s1_transport <- c("Lrp2", "Aqp1", "Slc34a1", "Ggt1", "Atp1a1", "Atp1b1")

# Solute transporter functions
organic_anion <- c("Slc22a6", "Slc22a8")   # OAT1, OAT3 – organic anion transport
amino_acid    <- c("Slc6a19")              # B0AT1 – neutral amino acid transport
uric_acid     <- c("Slc22a12")             # URAT1 – uric acid reabsorption
dicarboxylate <- c("Slc13a3")              # NaDC3 – dicarboxylate reabsorption
na_h_exchange <- c("Slc9a3")              # NHE3 – sodium-hydrogen exchange
glutamate     <- c("Slc1a1")              # EAAT3 – glutamate transport

#Common injured PT
#Common_injury_markers <- c("Havcr1", "Lcn2", "Clu","Dab2","Nrg1","Sox9","Krt8","Krt18","Krt19","Spp1")

# Cell proliferation -- Repairing PT
prolif_markers_g <- c("Mki67", "Foxm1","Top2a", "Pcna", "Ccna2","Ccnb1", "Cdk1")

# Dedifferentiation (loss of PT identity / maladaptive repair)
dediff_markers <- c("Vcam1", "Prom1", "Vim", "Cdh6", "Fn1", "Hif1a","Spp1", "Clu","Dab2","Nrg1","Havcr1")
# fatty acid oxidation
FAO_markers <- c(
"Ppara",
"Ppargc1a",
"Cpt1a",
"Ehhadh",
"Acsm3",
"Ldhd"
)
# Glycolysis
Glycolysis_markers <- c(
"Ldha",
"Gapdh",
"Ldhd",
"Hk2",
"Pfkp",
"Pkm"
)

all_g_markers <- c(
  s1_transport, organic_anion, amino_acid, uric_acid,
  dicarboxylate, na_h_exchange, glutamate,
  dediff_markers, prolif_markers_g, FAO_markers, Glycolysis_markers
)
all_g_markers <- unique(all_g_markers[all_g_markers %in% rownames(PTcells)])

Fig5G_DotPlot <- DotPlot(
  PTcells,
  features  = all_g_markers,
  cols      = c("RdBu"),
  dot.scale = 5
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(
    title = "PT transport function, dedifferentiation, and proliferation markers",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Cluster"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_colorbar(title = "AveExp"),
    size   = guide_legend(title  = "PerExp")
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5G_PT_Transport_Dediff_Prolif_DotPlot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5G_DotPlot,
  width    = 10, height = 4
)
Fig5G_DotPlot
```

## Figure 5H: CytoTRACE differentiation state analysis

```{r fig5h-cytotrace, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
# CytoTRACE scores transcriptional diversity per cell as a proxy for
# differentiation state: score ~1 = stem-like/undifferentiated, ~0 = fully differentiated
# Install if needed: devtools::install_github("gunsagargulati/CytoTRACE")
library(CytoTRACE)

Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = cluster_order)
DefaultAssay(PTcells) <- "RNA"

# CytoTRACE expects a genes × cells raw count matrix
ct_mat     <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(PTcells, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"))
ct_results <- CytoTRACE(ct_mat)

# Add score to metadata (align by cell barcode)
PTcells$CytoTRACE_score <- ct_results$CytoTRACE[colnames(PTcells)]

# Panel H1: UMAP colored by CytoTRACE score
Fig5H_UMAP <- FeaturePlot(
  PTcells,
  features = "CytoTRACE_score",
  pt.size  = 0.4,
  cols     = rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))
) +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE differentiation score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5H_PT_CytoTRACE_UMAP.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5H_UMAP,
  width    = 5, height = 4
)

# Panel H2: Violin plot of CytoTRACE score per cluster
Fig5H_Vln_Cluster <- VlnPlot(
  PTcells,
  features = "CytoTRACE_score",
  pt.size  = 0,
  cols     = brewer.pal(max(7, length(cluster_order)), "Set2")[seq_along(cluster_order)]
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE score by cluster", x = "Cluster", y = "CytoTRACE score") +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5H_PT_CytoTRACE_VlnCluster.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5H_Vln_Cluster,
  width    = 5, height = 4
)

# Panel H3: Violin plot of CytoTRACE score per timepoint
PTcells$DataSet <- factor(PTcells$DataSet, levels = timepoint_order)
Fig5H_Vln_Time <- VlnPlot(
  PTcells,
  features = "CytoTRACE_score",
  group.by = "DataSet",
  pt.size  = 0,
  cols     = brewer.pal(4, "Blues")
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE score by timepoint", x = "Timepoint", y = "CytoTRACE score") +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5H_PT_CytoTRACE_VlnTimepoint.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5H_Vln_Time,
  width    = 4, height = 4
)

Fig5H <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig5H_UMAP, Fig5H_Vln_Cluster, Fig5H_Vln_Time, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1.2, 1, 0.8))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5H_PT_CytoTRACE_Combined.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5H,
  width    = 12, height = 4
)
Fig5H
```

## Figure 5I: GO Biological Process enrichment dotplot per PT subset

```{r fig5i-go-enrichment, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = rev(cluster_order))
DefaultAssay(PTcells) <- "RNA"

AllMarkers_pt <- FindAllMarkers(
  PTcells,
  min.pct         = 0.25,
  #logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use        = "MAST",
  #only.pos        = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  AllMarkers_pt,
  file      = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5I_PT_DEGs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

#AllMarkers_pt <- read.csv(paste0(Outdir, "Figure5I_PT_DEGs.csv"))
AllMarkers_pt %>% head()
ClusterGenes_pt <- lapply(cluster_order, function(cl) {
  AllMarkers_pt %>%
    filter(cluster == cl, p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>%
    pull(gene)
})
names(ClusterGenes_pt) <- cluster_order
ClusterGenes_pt <- ClusterGenes_pt[sapply(ClusterGenes_pt, length) > 0]

GO_pt <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = ClusterGenes_pt,
  fun          = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb        = "org.Mm.eg.db",
  ont          = "BP",
  keyType      = "SYMBOL",
  pvalueCutoff = 1
)
saveRDS(GO_pt, paste0(Outdir, "Figure5I_PT_GO_BP.rds"))

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(GO_pt),
  file      = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5I_PT_GO_BP.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)



selected_go_pt <- c(
# PT Identity / Homeostasis
  "organic anion transport",
  "organic acid transport",
  "carboxylic acid transport",
  "sodium ion transport",
  "potassium ion transport",
  "fatty acid transport",
  "fatty acid metabolic process",
  "small molecule catabolic process",
  "steroid metabolic process",

# Mitochondrial Fitness
  "cellular respiration",
  "aerobic respiration",
  "oxidative phosphorylation",
  "electron transport chain",
  "ATP metabolic process",

# Oxidative Stress Adaptation
  "NADPH regeneration",
  "response to oxidative stress",
  "cellular response to oxidative stress",
  "response to reactive oxygen species",
  "cellular response to hydrogen peroxide",
  "response to hypoxia",

# Metabolic Reprogramming
  "canonical glycolysis",
  "glycolytic process",
  "glycogen metabolic process",
  "regulation of glycogen catabolic process",

# Inflammation
  "regulation of inflammatory response",
  "cytokine production involved in immune response",
  "tumor necrosis factor superfamily cytokine production",
  "neutrophil chemotaxis",
  "leukocyte migration",

# Regenerative Repair
  "DNA replication",
  "mitotic cell cycle",
  "cell division",
  "cell cycle G1/S phase transition",
  "cell cycle G2/M phase transition",
  "mitotic nuclear division",

# Plasticity / Dedifferentiation
  "regulation of epithelial cell proliferation",
  "regulation of epithelial cell differentiation",
  "epithelial cell development",
  "mesenchymal cell differentiation",
  "epithelial to mesenchymal transition",

# Fibrosis / Matrix Remodeling
  "extracellular matrix organization",
  "extracellular structure organization",
  "collagen fibril organization",
  "wound healing",
  "transforming growth factor beta receptor signaling pathway",

# Senescence/Cell death
  "cellular senescence",
  "replicative senescence",
  "response to DNA damage stimulus",
  "regulation of apoptotic signaling pathway",
  "defense response to bacterium"
)
# clusterProfiler's dotplot() re-orders internally and ignores factor levels.
# Build directly from the data with ggplot2 for exact control.
terms_present <- selected_go_pt[selected_go_pt %in% as.data.frame(GO_pt)$Description]

df_go <- as.data.frame(GO_pt) %>%
  filter(Description %in% terms_present) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneRatio   = sapply(GeneRatio, function(x) {
                    v <- as.numeric(strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]); v[1] / v[2]
                  }),
    Description = factor(Description, levels = terms_present), 
    Cluster     = factor(Cluster,     levels = rev(cluster_order))       
  )

# x = Cluster (bottom), y = Description (left) -> GO terms appear on the left side
Fig5I_GO <- ggplot(df_go, aes(x = Description, y = Cluster,
                               size = GeneRatio, color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#E31A1C", high = "steelblue", name = "p.adjust") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 6), name = "GeneRatio") +
  labs(title = "GO Biological Process - PT subsets", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5I_PT_GO_Dotplot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5I_GO,
  width    = 9, height = 5
)
Fig5I_GO
```

## Figure 5J: Monocle3 pseudotime trajectory of PT cells

```{r fig5j-monocle3-pseudotime, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
# Monocle2 is incompatible with modern dplyr (group_by_() removed in dplyr 0.8+).
# We use Monocle3 via SeuratWrappers instead — same biological result, fully compatible.
# Install if needed:
#   BiocManager::install("monocle3")
#   remotes::install_github("satijalab/seurat-wrappers")
library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)

Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = cluster_order)
DefaultAssay(PTcells) <- "RNA"

# Convert Seurat → Monocle3 CellDataSet (reuses Seurat UMAP embedding)
cds <- as.cell_data_set(PTcells)

# Re-use the existing Seurat UMAP so trajectory is overlaid on the same layout
cds@int_colData$reducedDims$UMAP <- Embeddings(PTcells, "umap")[colnames(cds), ]

# Cluster cells (uses Seurat partition) and learn trajectory graph
cds <- cluster_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
cds <- learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE)

# Root the trajectory at cells from clusters 0 and 1 at 0DPI
get_root_nodes <- function(cds_obj) {
  origin_cell_ids <- which(
    colData(cds_obj)$DataSet         == "0DPI" &
    colData(cds_obj)$seurat_clusters %in% c("0", "1")
  )
  closest_vertex <- cds_obj@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds_obj), ])
  root_nodes <- igraph::V(principal_graph(cds_obj)[["UMAP"]])$name[
    as.numeric(names(which.max(table(closest_vertex[origin_cell_ids, ]))))
  ]
  root_nodes
}
cds <- order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = get_root_nodes(cds))

# Store pseudotime in Seurat metadata for downstream plotting
PTcells$Pseudotime <- pseudotime(cds)[colnames(PTcells)]

# Panel J1: UMAP colored by cluster with trajectory graph
Fig5J_Cluster <- plot_cells(
  cds,
  color_cells_by        = "seurat_clusters",
  label_cell_groups     = TRUE,
  label_leaves          = TRUE,
  label_branch_points   = TRUE,
  graph_label_size      = 1.5,
  cell_size             = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "PT trajectory - cluster") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

# Panel J2: UMAP colored by pseudotime
Fig5J_Pseudo <- plot_cells(
  cds,
  color_cells_by        = "pseudotime",
  label_cell_groups     = FALSE,
  label_leaves          = FALSE,
  label_branch_points   = FALSE,
  cell_size             = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "PT trajectory - pseudotime") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

# Panel J3: UMAP colored by timepoint
Fig5J_Time <- plot_cells(
  cds,
  color_cells_by        = "DataSet",
  label_cell_groups     = FALSE,
  label_leaves          = FALSE,
  label_branch_points   = FALSE,
  cell_size             = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "PT trajectory - timepoint") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

Fig5J <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig5J_Cluster, Fig5J_Pseudo, Fig5J_Time, nrow = 1)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5J_PT_Monocle3_Pseudotime.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5J,
  width    = 14, height = 4
)
Fig5J
```

## Figure 5K: PT state module scores projected onto spatial ATLAS
### Logic: A spot is shown only if it passes both thresholds:

#         PT_Identity score > 0 → spot is PT-positive
#         Status score > 0 → spot also expresses the stress/injury signature

```{r fig5k-spatial-pt-states, fig.width=15, fig.height=3}
# Load spatial ATLAS
SpatialIndir <- "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/SpatialTranscriptomic/Results/Deconvolution_Six_V01262026/"
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- readRDS(paste0(
  SpatialIndir,
  "Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_with_PROGENyCandidatePath_v05292026.rds"
))
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- UpdateSeuratObject(Pyelonephritis_Infection)
DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- "SCT"

# PT state gene signatures derived directly from single-cell cluster markers

# Anchor: canonical PT identity (used to mask non-PT spots)
PT_Identity <- c("Lrp2", "Slc34a1", "Slc22a6", "Slc22a8", "Slc5a12", "Ggt1", "Dab2")

# Cluster 2: Adaptive Stress PT
# Most differentiated; S1/S2 transporters + low-level stress markers
C2_Adaptive_Stress <- c("Slc34a1", "Slc5a12", "Slc22a6", "Slc22a8", "Slc22a2",
                         "Igfbp7", "Cst3", "Hspd1", "Hsp90aa1")

# Cluster 3: Hmox1+ Oxidative Stress PT
# Cytoprotective oxidative stress / heat-shock; maintains epithelial identity
C3_Oxidative_Stress <- c("Hmox1", "Hspd1", "Hsp90aa1", "Hsp90ab1", "Dab2")

# Cluster 4: Metabolic Stress PT
# Glycolytic reprogramming + proteotoxic stress; reduced transporter expression
C4_Metabolic_Stress <- c("Ldha", "Gapdh", "Hspd1", "Hsp90aa1", "Hsp90ab1")

# Cluster 5: Kim1+ Injured/Repairing PT
# Active regeneration: tubular injury + robust cell-cycle activation
C5_Repairing_PT <- c("Havcr1", "Foxm1", "Top2a", "Pcna", "Ccna2", "Ccnb1")

# Cluster 1: Spp1+ VCAM1+ Maladaptive Repair PT
# EMT, inflammation, profibrotic; still retains some transport genes
C1_Maladaptive_Repair <- c("Vcam1", "Vim", "Prom1", "Clu", "Spp1", "Cxcl1", "Cxcl2", "Ccl5")

# Cluster 6: Kim1+ Igfbp7+ Maladaptive PT
# Severe injury; profibrotic + senescence markers
C6_Kim1_Maladaptive <- c("Havcr1", "Igfbp7", "Lcn2", "Spp1", "Tgfb1", "Agt", "Gdf15", "Cdkn2a")

# Cluster 0: Spp1+ Chronic Injury PT
# Persistent chronic injury; senescence without active repair
C0_Chronic_Injury <- c("Spp1", "Igfbp7", "Serpine1", "Cdkn2a")

# Nephron segment identity markers
# S1: outer cortex; megalin-high, SGLT2, OAT1
S1_Segment <-  c("Lrp2","Cubn","Slc34a1","Slc5a12")

# S2: mid-cortex; 
S2_Segment <- c("Slc5a2","Slc22a6","Slc22a8","Slc13a2","Slc22a2")

# S3: corticomedullary junction; Kim1-prone zone
S3_Segment <- c("Aqp7","Slc7a13","Slc7a12","Inmt")


# S1_biased_markers <- c("Lrp2","Cubn","Slc34a1","Slc5a12")

# S2_biased_markers <- c("Slc5a2","Slc22a6","Slc22a8","Slc13a2","Slc22a2")

# S2_biased__markers <- c("Aqp7","Slc7a13","Slc7a12","Inmt")

# Filter each signature to genes present in the spatial object
pt_signatures <- list(
  PT_Identity        = PT_Identity[PT_Identity %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  C2_Adaptive_Stress = C2_Adaptive_Stress[C2_Adaptive_Stress %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  C3_Oxidative_Stress = C3_Oxidative_Stress[C3_Oxidative_Stress %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  C4_Metabolic_Stress = C4_Metabolic_Stress[C4_Metabolic_Stress %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  C5_Repairing_PT    = C5_Repairing_PT[C5_Repairing_PT %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  C1_Maladaptive_Repair = C1_Maladaptive_Repair[C1_Maladaptive_Repair %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  C6_Kim1_Maladaptive = C6_Kim1_Maladaptive[C6_Kim1_Maladaptive %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  C0_Chronic_Injury  = C0_Chronic_Injury[C0_Chronic_Injury %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  S1_Segment         = S1_Segment[S1_Segment %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  S2_Segment         = S2_Segment[S2_Segment %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)],
  S3_Segment         = S3_Segment[S3_Segment %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)]
)

cat("Genes retained per signature:\n")
print(sapply(pt_signatures, length))

# Compute module scores (AddModuleScore uses ctrl genes for background correction)
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- AddModuleScore(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection,
  features = pt_signatures,
  name     = names(pt_signatures),
  seed     = 42
)

# Column names are appended with 1,2,3... by AddModuleScore
score_cols <- paste0(names(pt_signatures), seq_along(pt_signatures))
cat("Score columns added:", paste(score_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Spatial feature plots for each signature across all 6 timepoints
myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))

for (i in seq_along(score_cols)) {
  col   <- score_cols[i]
  label <- names(pt_signatures)[i]

  Maxvalue <- ceiling(max(Pyelonephritis_Infection[[col]][, 1]))
  Minvalue <- floor(min(Pyelonephritis_Infection[[col]][, 1]))

  p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    features       = col,
    pt.size.factor = 1600,
    crop           = TRUE
  ) &
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = myPalette(4),
      limits  = c(Minvalue, Maxvalue),
      name    = label
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5K_Spatial_", label, "_Score.pdf"),
    plot     = p,
    height   = 3,
    width    = 15
  )
}
```

## Figure 5L: PT-positive spots only – status score spatial feature plots

```{r fig5l-spatial-pt-masked, fig.width=15, fig.height=3}
# PT_Identity score column is the first one added (PT_Identity1)
pt_score_col <- score_cols[1]   # "PT_Identity1"

# Threshold: spots with PT_Identity score > 0 are considered PT-positive.
# AddModuleScore centers scores around 0, so >0 = above background expression.
pt_positive <- Pyelonephritis_Infection[[pt_score_col]][, 1] > 0
cat("PT-positive spots:", sum(pt_positive), "/", ncol(Pyelonephritis_Infection), "\n")

# For each STATUS signature (all except PT_Identity), create a masked column:
# score is kept for spots that are PT+ AND status+; set to NA otherwise.
status_score_cols  <- score_cols[-1]                       # drop PT_Identity1
status_score_names <- names(pt_signatures)[-1]

masked_cols <- character(length(status_score_cols))

for (i in seq_along(status_score_cols)) {
  col    <- status_score_cols[i]
  label  <- status_score_names[i]
  scores <- Pyelonephritis_Infection[[col]][, 1]

  status_positive <- scores > 0
  co_positive     <- pt_positive & status_positive

  cat(label, "– co-positive spots:", sum(co_positive), "\n")

  masked_scores        <- ifelse(co_positive, scores, NA)
  masked_col           <- paste0(col, "_PTmasked")
  masked_cols[i]       <- masked_col
  Pyelonephritis_Infection[[masked_col]] <- masked_scores
}

# Plot each masked score – non-PT / non-status spots render as light grey (na.value)
myPalette_status <-  colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))

for (i in seq_along(masked_cols)) {
  masked_col <- masked_cols[i]
  label      <- status_score_names[i]

  valid_scores <- Pyelonephritis_Infection[[masked_col]][, 1]
  valid_scores <- valid_scores[!is.na(valid_scores)]

  if (length(valid_scores) == 0) {
    message("No co-positive spots for ", label, " – skipping.")
    next
  }

  Maxvalue <- ceiling(max(valid_scores)-0.05)
  Minvalue <- floor(min(valid_scores))

  p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    features       = masked_col,
    pt.size.factor = 1600,
    crop           = TRUE
  ) &
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours  = myPalette_status(8),
      limits   = c(Minvalue, Maxvalue),
      na.value = "lightgrey",
      name     = label
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5L_Spatial_", label, "_PTposOnly.pdf"),
    plot     = p,
    height   = 3,
    width    = 20
  )
}
```
